items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: security baseline covers 61 managed sites, but fleet-doctor has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are not evidenced. No credential exposure, exploit, or vulnerability is established. Compliance reports 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown and is technical baseline only, not certification. Exact decision: do not clear go-live or security-sensitive releases; preserve existing private and gated dispositions; continue only canonical read-only evidence work and bounded reversible growth; do not create duplicate telemetry, retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions/configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or conduct external outreach.

Security accepts the candidate plan's containment posture only as a conditional risk disposition, not as security clearance. Reject new production, queue, dependency, credential, configuration, telemetry, and research admissions this cycle. Retain only existing canonical work after capacity and site-overlap clearance, with normal release review. Reassess when dated evidence exists for access control, secrets, isolation, release integrity, dependencies, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure readiness.
